svg.text: STATE IS FILL, 4.5. ACCENTS ARE MODIFIERS, RANKED TASK, HAZARD, CHANGED, TWO AT A TIME, 4.7. THE FIELD IS NOTHING; THE NULL TILE IS A HOLE THAT MATTERS, 4.6.

svg.text: RUNNING IS MOTION, NOT A FILL; A STILL CANNOT SHOW IT. THE TASK RING PULSES. NO FONT IS CHOSEN; THE SHEET USES THE SYSTEM SANS.
